Sunny Moon Village

Villa in Nai Harn
HomeNew ProjectsSunny Moon Village

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A gated community of single-storey villas in Nai Harn from Sunny Development Group, with 2, 3 and 4 bedroom homes of about 149 to 215 sqm. Each villa has its own pool and sunrise-facing orientation, and residents share the wellness and sports amenities of the neighbouring Sunny Moon project.

Facilities & amenities

  • Private pools and sunbathing terraces
  • Smart home technology
  • Gym
  • Spa
  • Padel court
  • Co-working space
  • Kids play areas
  • Concierge lobby
  • Cafes
  • Shuttle service

Frequently asked questions

Where is Sunny Moon Village?

Sunny Moon Village is a pool villa project in Nai Harn, Phuket, developed by Sunny Development Group.

What is the starting price of Sunny Moon Village?

The advertised starting price is ฿12,243,000, last checked 2026-11-12. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Sunny Moon Village?

Sources list leasehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Sunny Moon Village be ready?

Current status: under construction. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
